description: The built-in Text component (core/franklin/components/text/v1/text): a fixed model, only its text is delivered (aem.live component model definitions). Its text styles (the Rich Text block's Style options, KB-D-083) are Section fields, sectionFields below, spread into the Section model (Text tab) and delivered as section metadata; utils/text-styles.js and styles/styles.css apply them to the section's default content.

sectionFields.name: textAlign
sectionFields.label: Text alignment
sectionFields.description: The alignment of the section's text (Text, Title and buttons; blocks keep their own).

sectionFields.name: textSize
sectionFields.label: Text size
sectionFields.description: The size of the paragraphs and lists of the section's text (headings keep their level's size).

sectionFields.name: textLead
sectionFields.label: First paragraph
sectionFields.description: Shows the section's first paragraph larger, as an introduction.

sectionFields.name: textColor
sectionFields.label: Text colour
sectionFields.description: The colour of the section's text (light on Dark and Dark Green sections).

sectionFields.name: textColumns
sectionFields.label: Text columns
sectionFields.description: Flows the section's text into columns; one on mobile.

sectionFields.name: underlineStyle
sectionFields.label: Underlined text
sectionFields.description: How the words underlined with the toolbar are shown in the section's text: the way to colour words, since Edge Delivery doesn't publish text colour.

sectionFields.name: textDirection
sectionFields.label: Text direction
sectionFields.description: Right to left for the section's text in Arabic, Hebrew and other right-to-left languages.

sectionFields.name: externalLinks
sectionFields.label: Links to other sites
sectionFields.description: Opens the links to other websites in the section's text in a new tab (announced to screen readers).
